0.title: Million Dollar Question
0.description: Ask a stranger: "What would you do if you won a million right now?"
hints: "What's at the top of your list?"

1.title: Say hello
1.description: Say hello to a stranger as you pass by.

2.title: Style compliment
2.description: Ask someone where they got their outfit or shoes.
hints: "Those shoes are amazing, where did you get them?"
"May I ask where you bought that?"

3.title: Sympathy compliment
3.description: Tell someone that they have a pleasant charisma.
hints: "It's easy to tell that you spread good cheer."

4.title: Small talk for directions
4.description: Ask someone for directions and then have 2-3 sentences of small talk.
hints: "Excuse me, can you help me for a moment?"

5.title: Traffic light compliment
5.description: Tell someone at the traffic light that they're beaming and wish them a nice day.
hints: "Keep it up, you make the street more beautiful."

6.title: Waitress' smile
6.description: Compliment the server on their smile.
hints: "Thank you, you really have a beautiful smile."

7.title: Love at first sight
7.description: Ask someone if they believe in love at first sight.
hints: "Do you believe in love at first sight?"

8.title: Lost Bet Ice Cream
8.description: Say you lost a bet and have to ask them about their favorite ice cream flavor.
hints: "I lost a bet... what's your favorite flavor?"
"Help me please, otherwise I'll have to do more nonsense."
"So, which ice cream is your favorite?"

9.title: Headphone Music
9.description: Ask someone what they're listening to on their headphones.
hints: "May I ask what you're listening to?"

10.title: Selfie with a reason
10.description: Take a selfie with someone and say it's for your challenge.
hints: "For my challenge: a selfie with the most beautiful smile in town."
"Would you like to join me for a minute?"
"I only need one photo, then I'll leave you alone."

11.title: Look familiar
11.description: Walk up to a person and say that they look familiar to you.

12.title: Perfume compliment
12.description: Tell someone that their perfume smells amazing. Works best when you're sitting nearby.

13.title: Direct Compliment
13.description: Say: "I have to say, you look incredibly good." and then just move on.

14.title: If we meet again
14.description: Tell a person you like that you would owe them an ice cream should you ever happen to cross paths again.
hints: "Deal? If I see you again, ice cream on me."

15.title: Number when leaving
15.description: As you walk away, say: "If I'm brave enough to talk to you, you're brave enough to give me your number."
hints: "I am, so now it's your turn."
"Otherwise we'll never see each other again."

16.title: Wingman Mission
16.description: Go up to a group of people with a friend and introduce yourselves charmingly.
hints: "Hi, we wanted to get to know you."
"You look nice, thought we'd say hi."
"We're on a courage mission right now."

17.title: Dance Challenge
17.description: Challenge a group of people to a short TikTok dance.

18.title: Group Instagram
18.description: Go up to a group of people and ask if you can take a group photo for Insta.
hints: "Can we take a group photo for Insta?"

19.title: Beauty Jury
19.description: Pretend you are judges and award points for outfits.

20.title: Who is single?
20.description: Ask directly: "Quick statistics round, which of you is single?"

21.title: Have your friend judged
21.description: Introduce a friend: "On a scale of 1-10, how cute is he?"
hints: "Don't worry, he'll only cry for a moment."

22.title: Pick-Up Quiz
22.description: Say: "We're practicing pick-up lines, rate them from 1-10."

23.title: Selfie Battle
23.description: Have a selfie competition: whoever takes the funniest picture with the group wins.

24.title: Blind Date Call
24.description: Ask a group: "Do you know anyone you can introduce us to?"

25.title: Shared Story
25.description: Make a Boomerang or short Insta video with a group.

26.title: Fake Bachelor
26.description: Pretend you're at the Bachelor casting: "Who gets the rose?"

27.title: Worst Pick-Up Line
27.description: Say: "We're collecting the worst pick-up lines. Do you have any?"

28.title: Spontaneous Karaoke
28.description: Start singing out loud and invite the group to join in.

29.title: Flirt Scale
29.description: Ask a person you like how they would rate their own flirting skills on a scale of 1 to 10.
hints: "I'd be interested to see your score."

30.title: WhatsApp now
30.description: Tell someone they had a really cool vibe and that it would be a shame if that were the last conversation, then finish by asking if they had WhatsApp.

31.title: Send something later
31.description: Ask someone if you could send them something funny later and ask them to give you their number.
hints: "Give me your number, send you something funny later."
"It will be worth it, I promise."

32.title: We should see each other again
32.description: Tell someone you would bet they were someone who should be seen more often and ask them what they thought about that.

33.title: Music video
33.description: Tell someone as you walk past that they looked like they had stepped straight out of a music video.
hints: "You look like you're in a music video."

34.title: Spontaneous Date
34.description: Ask someone what they were doing right now and suggest getting a coffee somewhere together spontaneously.

35.title: Give me a compliment
35.description: Tell someone to give you a compliment, as you had just earned one.
hints: "I just took a risk, reward me."
"I'm curious to see what you come up with."

36.title: Right after number
36.description: Say: "I find you super interesting. Give me your number, we should do this again."
hints: "It would be a shame if we didn't continue this."

37.title: Type in phone number
37.description: Hand the person your phone in the middle of a conversation and tell them to trust you that this was the best thing that had happened to them all day as they typed in their number.
hints: "Give me your phone for a minute."

38.title: Date Provocation
38.description: Say: "We should go on a date – you seem like you'll miss me otherwise."

39.title: Address a group
39.description: Walk up to a group and introduce yourself to everyone at once.

40.title: Dare game for two
40.description: Say to someone: "We both have to compliment a stranger. Whoever laughs first loses."

41.title: Awkward Story Duel
41.description: Say: "Let's dare: we both tell an embarrassing story. Whoever is more embarrassing wins."

42.title: Handshake Poker
42.description: Play rock-paper-scissors with a group. The loser has to reveal a secret.
hints: "Only fair, whoever loses has to deliver."

43.title: Give a nickname
43.description: Spontaneously give everyone in the group a funny nickname. You are assigning different identities. This is an extremely dominant social act.
hints: "I've thought of something dangerous for you."

44.title: Find the best flirt
44.description: Ask: "Who of you is the best at flirting?". You're throwing a provoking question into a group.

45.title: Fake Wedding Photo
45.description: Take a posed "couple" photo with someone you meet, with the group as the audience.
hints: "We need you as our wedding party."

46.title: In love? Test
46.description: Ask a person you like what someone would have to do for them to fall in love instantly.

47.title: Spontaneous speed dating
47.description: Everyone in your group speaks briefly to everyone in their group.

48.title: Who pays first?
48.description: Suggest a coin toss: If you win, they owe you an ice cream – otherwise the other way around.

49.title: Fashion show on the street
49.description: Challenge the group: "Who has the best runway walk?"

50.title: Spontaneous friend request
50.description: Tell someone they looked so cool that you two had to be official friends now.

51.title: Would You Rather
51.description: Start a "Would You Rather?" game with the group.
hints: "We'll start: Who would you most likely marry someone on vacation?"

52.title: Instagram Swap
52.description: Give each other your phones and follow each other directly on Insta.

53.title: Introduce Syntra
53.description: Approach someone to introduce Syntra and ask for their thoughts on the concept, with the option to showcase the app and complete the challenge once you are together.
hints: "Do you know social apps like Syntra?"
"What do you think of a courage challenge app like this?"

54.title: Ask about their work
54.description: Ask: "You look interesting, what do you do for a living?" and then ask two questions about it.
hints: "What do you like most about it?"

55.title: Hello to 5 strangers
55.description: Say hello to 5 strangers as they pass by. Smile and maintain eye contact.

56.title: AI Small Talk
56.description: Start small talk or flirting and say "wait a minute" 3 sentences later, then pretend to ask AI.

57.title: Earring Compliment
57.description: Find someone with earrings and say that they caught your eye.

58.title: Flower Gift
58.description: Buy or pick a flower and give it to someone without wanting anything in return.

59.title: Style compliments
59.description: Compliment a woman's and a man's style.

60.title: Girl with mother
60.description: Talk to a girl who is out with her mother.
hints: "Just wanted to say hi to your daughter."

61.title: Talk to mother
61.description: Talk to the mother of a girl.

62.title: Restaurant compliment
62.description: Walk up to an outdoor table and tell the people that they were the best-looking table there and that you wanted to wish them a pleasant meal.
hints: "I just had to get that off my chest."
"Do with that info what you want."

63.title: Syntra Feedback
63.description: Go to a group of friends: "You look like you go out a lot. Can I ask you something?" Introduce Syntra and get feedback.
hints: "Do you think the idea is cool?"

64.title: Water for cashier
64.description: Buy something for yourself + an extra water and give it to the person at the checkout.

65.title: Group Courage
65.description: Approach a group and introduce yourself to everyone at once: "Hi, I'm [Name], you all look so nice, I had to meet you."

66.title: Tell them they have great smile
66.description: Tell someone as you walk past that you simply had to let them know they have a truly great smile.
hints: "Sorry, I just had to say that."

67.title: Admire a beard
67.description: Stop a person with a beard and ask if they would tell you how long it took them to grow it, because you were envious.

68.title: Waiting Game Compliment
68.description: Approach someone after they have finished their phone call and tell them that you had to wait because you just had to let them know you thought their outfit was great.
hints: "Sorry, I had to wait until you were finished."

69.title: Praise a bag
69.description: Say to someone with a colorful bag that you like their bag

70.title: Praise striking hair
70.description: Approach a red-haired person and tell them that their hair was amazing and you simply had to let that out.

71.title: Ask a skateboard trick
71.description: Ask someone with a skateboard: "Can you do a trick? I'll give you a standing ovation."

72.title: Outfit Compliment
72.description: Say to someone in a standout outfit: "It's only a quick one, but that looks incredibly good on you."

73.title: Couple newly in love
73.description: Approach a couple and tell them you just had to say they looked like they were newly in love.

74.title: Sunglasses compliment
74.description: Say to someone wearing sunglasses: "You look so mysterious in those glasses. On purpose?"

75.title: Coffee-to-go question
75.description: Approach someone with a coffee-to-go cup and ask them if that was the best coffee in town or if the cup was just for show.
hints: "Does the coffee here really taste that good?"
"I'm always looking for the best coffee."

76.title: Elegance despite haste
76.description: Say to someone who is hurrying: "Don't worry, you are still elegance personified."

77.title: Ask to Adopt
77.description: Approach a group and ask if they could adopt you for a moment, as they looked like they were having a lot of fun.
hints: "I'm about to meet with a friend"

78.title: Praise a funny shirt
78.description: Approach someone with a funny shirt and tell them that their shirt was awesome, then ask where one could get something like that.

79.title: Praise large earrings
79.description: Stop someone with particularly large earrings and say: "Can I say that your earrings are a real statement?"

80.title: Best thing this week
80.description: Ask a stranger: "Spontaneously... what is the best thing that happened to you this week?"

81.title: Praise dream hair
81.description: Say to someone with long hair: "Sorry, but your hair is a dream."

82.title: Read a jute bag
82.description: Approach someone with a tote bag and ask if you could take a moment to read what was written on it, as you were curious to see what it said.

83.title: Praise neon colors
83.description: Say to someone wearing neon colors: "Okay, wow, you're really adding color here."

84.title: Praise laughter
84.description: Say to someone who is laughing: "Your laughter is contagious, please keep going."

85.title: Secret Group
85.description: Stop a group and tell them they looked like they had a secret, then ask what their plan for the day was.

86.title: Piercing brave
86.description: Say to someone with a piercing: "Brave! I've always wanted to, but I'm a coward."

87.title: Spontaneous wisdom
87.description: Ask a stranger if you could buy a piece of spontaneous wisdom from them.
hints: "Do you have a spontaneous piece of wisdom for me?"

88.title: Take a photo of pink hair
88.description: Find someone with pink hair and ask if you can take a photo of their hair.
hints: "Can I take a photo of your hair?"
"I've never seen a color like that before."
"Mega cool, can I take a picture?"

89.title: Compliment eye-catching jewelry
89.description: Find someone with eye-catching jewelry (e.g. large earrings or a bold necklace) and compliment them.

90.title: Full Beard Viking
90.description: Find a man with a full beard and tell him he looks like a Viking.

91.title: Ask about a band shirt
91.description: Spot someone wearing a band shirt (AC/DC, Nirvana, etc.) and ask if they've seen the band live.
hints: "Have you ever been to a concert by the band?"

92.title: Sneakers from ...?
92.description: Find a person with colored sneakers and ask where they got them.
hints: "I'm looking for some like that too."

93.title: Ask about tattoo meaning
93.description: Find someone with a tattoo on their arm and ask what it means.

94.title: Lipstick Compliment
94.description: Spot someone wearing bold, bright lipstick and tell them the color looks amazing.

95.title: Pet the dog
95.description: Find someone with a dog, ask what its name is and if you can pet the dog.

96.title: Group dressed in black
96.description: Find a group that is all dressed in black and ask if they are a band.
hints: "I'm curious to hear what you play."

97.title: Care tips for long hair
97.description: Find someone with very long hair and ask if they have any tips on how to care for it.
hints: "How do you care for your hair?"
"So long, it must be a lot of work."
"My friend is looking for a new hair routine?"

98.title: Take a photo of a skateboard
98.description: Find someone with a skateboard or longboard and take a photo of the board.
hints: "Can I take a photo of your board?"
"Looks cool, what kind of tricks do you do?"

99.title: Read out funny shirt
99.description: Find a person with a funny T-shirt, read the saying out loud and laugh together.
hints: "What does it say? Haha, that's good!"
"I've never seen a shirt like that before."

100.title: Selfie with Sunglasses Group
100.description: Find a group where at least one person is wearing sunglasses and take a selfie with them.

101.title: Flip-Flops Summer Saying
101.description: Find someone wearing flip-flops and tell them that they were truly living the summer vibe.

102.title: Couple Holding Hands
102.description: Find a couple holding hands and wish them a nice day.
hints: "You look cute, have a nice day!"

103.title: Compliment painted fingernails
103.description: Find someone with strikingly painted fingernails and pay them a compliment.
hints: "So well-groomed. Did you get them recently?"

104.title: Waiting on the Phone
104.description: Find someone who is currently on the phone, wait until they are finished, and tell them they looked as though they were having a very important conversation.
hints: "Thanks for waiting, I needed to talk to you."

105.title: Ask a laughing group
105.description: Find a group that is laughing, go to them and ask what was so funny.

106.title: Praise barefoot on a meadow
106.description: Find someone who is walking barefoot on a meadow and say: "Being barefoot is the best feeling, isn't it?"

107.title: Summer Flower Compliment
107.description: Find someone with a floral pattern on their dress, scarf, or shirt and say: "You really bring summer vibes with you."

108.title: Football Shirt Player Question
108.description: Find someone with a football shirt and ask if they play.

109.title: Listen to a music group
109.description: Find a group where someone plays guitar or makes music and listen for a bit.

110.title: Selfie with unusual hair color
110.description: Find someone with unusual hair color (blue, green, etc.) and take a selfie with them.
hints: "Can I take a photo with you?"

111.title: Ask about favorite ice cream flavor
111.description: Find someone who eats ice cream and ask what their favorite flavor is.
hints: "Which ice cream flavor do you like best?"

112.title: Like a Gentleman
112.description: Hold the door open and make eye contact with the next person who passes

113.title: Wave together
113.description: Wave at a stranger together with a friend, both of you, same time

114.title: Transit presence
114.description: Sit on public transport and look around for 30 seconds without looking at your phone

115.title: Immovable Object
115.description: Stop walking and stand still for 30 seconds in a crowded area.

116.title: Cashier goodbye
116.description: Say 'have a great day' to a cashier as you leave.

117.title: Barista favorite
117.description: Ask a barista what their favorite drink on the menu is.

118.title: Weather comment
118.description: Comment on the weather to someone next to you at a crossing.

119.title: Ask the time
119.description: Ask a stranger what time it is.
hints: "Excuse me, do you have the time?"

120.title: Shop compliment
120.description: Tell the person at checkout one thing you like about the shop.
hints: "You have such a nice selection here."

121.title: Waiter recommendation
121.description: Ask a waiter or server what dish they'd recommend.

122.title: Transit direction
122.description: Ask someone on the bus or train if this is the right stop for a specific location.
hints: "Excuse me, is this the right stop for...?"
"Do you know if this goes to...?"

123.title: Shop assistant question
123.description: Ask a shop assistant where something is.

124.title: Goodbye moment
124.description: Say 'bye' or 'have a good one' to someone as you both leave a place.

125.title: Event small talk
125.description: Ask someone at an event how long they've been there.

126.title: Photo WITH you
126.description: Ask someone to take a photo WITH you. No explanation needed.
hints: "Can you be in a photo with me?"

127.title: Spontaneous dance
127.description: Start a spontaneous dance move in a public space and hold it for 30 seconds.

128.title: Vulnerability opener
128.description: Sit next to a stranger and open with a personal disclosure.
hints: "Mind if I tell you something that happened to me today?"

129.title: Absurd street survey
129.description: Conduct an absurd 'street survey' on a ridiculous opinion question.

130.title: Lie on a bench
130.description: Lie down on a public bench and stay there for 60 seconds.
hints: Find a park or public bench

131.title: Shout something positive
131.description: Shout something genuinely positive out loud in a busy area.
hints: Then carry on like nothing happened

132.title: Skip down the street
132.description: Skip instead of walk through a busy street for 2 full minutes.

133.title: Emotional vulnerability
133.description: Tell a stranger something genuinely vulnerable within 60 seconds of meeting them.
hints: A fear, failure, or moment of weakness

134.title: Shout to the crowd
134.description: Stand in a busy area and shout something positive to nobody in particular.
hints: 'What a day to be alive!' or 'This is amazing!'

135.title: Approach 10 strangers
135.description: Approach 10 strangers in a row with different bold openers.
hints: Each with a different opening line
Don't stop until all 10 are done

136.title: Impromptu speech
136.description: Give a 1-minute impromptu speech to whoever is nearby.
hints: Stand in a moderately crowded place
Don't apologize or explain, just talk

137.title: Hold the awkwardness
137.description: Do something deliberately awkward in public and hold it for 60 seconds.
hints: Stand on one leg, hop, make strange faces
Hold it for a full 60 seconds

138.title: Compliment tour
138.description: Give genuine compliments to 10 strangers in 15 minutes.

139.title: Lie on the ground
139.description: Lie down on the ground in a busy public space for 90 seconds.
hints: People will walk by and stare

140.title: Full-volume scream
140.description: Let out a full-volume genuine scream in a busy public space.
hints: Not a threat, just raw energy

141.title: Sing opera loudly
141.description: Sing opera loudly in a busy public space for 3 minutes.
hints: Pick a busy street or plaza
Sing dramatically, don't worry about being good
Make sure people know what you're doing

142.title: Embarrassing sign
142.description: Hold a sign at a busy intersection with something embarrassing about yourself.
hints: 'I cry at Disney movies' or 'I practice singing in the shower'

143.title: Fake announcement
143.description: Make a calm, confident 'fake announcement' on public transport.
hints: Stand up and speak to the whole car
'Ladies and gentlemen, I'd like to remind you to smile at least once today'
Act natural when you sit down

144.title: Conga line
144.description: Get 3+ strangers to form a conga line and dance down a busy street.
hints: Convince at least 3 to join you
Dance for at least 30 seconds together

145.title: 3-minute performance
145.description: Perform a 3-minute 'show' that draws and keeps a crowd's attention.
hints: Tell jokes badly, do exaggerated movements, sing off-key
Draw at least 5 people to watch
Keep them there for all 3 minutes
